column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE CIVIL PROCEDURE CODE

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

column2: This Act may be cited as the Civil Procedure Code
Section  338  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column1: amended  in  subsection  (3)  thereof,  by  the  substitution  for
paragraph (b) thereof, of the following paragraph :—

column2: ‘ “legal  representative”  means  an  executor  or
administrator or in the case of an estate below the
value of rupees four million, the next of kin who
have  adiated  the  inheritance:
Provided  however,  that  in  the  event  of  any
dispute arising as to who is the legal representative
the  provisions  of  section  397  shall,  mutatis
mutandis, apply.’.
Section  394  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column1: amended  in  subsection  (2)  thereof  by  the  substitution  for
the  definition  for  the  expression  “legal  representative”  of

column2: ‘ “legal  representative”  means  an  executor  or
administrator or in the case of an estate below the
value of rupees four million, the next of kin who
have adiated the inheritance.’.
Section  524  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column1: amended by the repeal of subsection (4) of that section and
the substitution therefor, of the following subsection :—

column2: “(4)  The  petitioner  shall  tender  with  the  petition
proof  of  payment  of  charges  to  cover  the  cost  of
publication of the notice under section 529.”.
